main_text.p: Apud Syracusanos τίμων pro τίμε: sic εἰπὸν pro εἰπέ. Attice τιμόντων pro τιμέ-τωσαν
Vltima communiter gravatur: at εἰ-πὲ dic, ἀρὲ inveni, ἐλθὲ veni, acuun-tur. Sic Attice, λαβὲ cape, ἰδὲ vide.
Futurum quintum in μι, hîc deniq; proprium est.
Ἡς & δὸς, hîc sunt pro ἡτῇ, δὸῆ. Sic ἐς pro ἐῇ, ab ἵημι mitto: & ᾳ̈ς habeto,

page.notes: Several Greek words are uncertain in the scan (accents and breathings in the verb forms of sections 1–3 and the last line); marked as printed as best read. The last line is faint and partly obscured by a stain.
